name: Dwarf Rangers

specialRules.name: Don't Trust 'Em
specialRules.text: Members of a Dwarf Rangers warband are never considered friendly models to other Dwarfs and vice versa: they stop each other Marching and do not prevent All Alone tests. They do not count as enemies and may split treasure as normal.

specialRules.name: Dwarf Warband rules
specialRules.text: Also subject to the special rules for Dwarf Warbands (not included in this PDF).

equipmentLists.name: Dwarf Warrior equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Runesmith, Apprentice Runesmith, Troll Slayers, Longbeards, Clansmen, Beardlings

items.name: Gromril Weapon
items.note: 3x normal cost of the weapon (starting warband only); any weapon a Dwarf may buy can be a Gromril weapon

items.name: Gromril Armour
items.note: Starting warband price only; later purchases use the normal Price Chart

fighters.name: Runesmith

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Runesmith may use his Leadership when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Inscribe Runes
specialRules.text: Knows one minor rune (rolled on the Dwarf Runes table at creation). Before each game may roll 2D6 to inscribe it on an item carried by a warband member (success on 2D6 equal to or greater than the rune's Difficulty; the bonus lasts for that game; a natural 2 destroys the item). On a Hero Advance skill roll may learn a new rune instead of a skill.

fighters.notes: Dwarfs may never take Arcane Lore. Minor runes: Stone (+1 armour save, Diff 8), Sharpness (-1 save modifier on weapon, Diff 6), Speed (Initiative doubled on weapon, Diff 7), Warding (special 4+ save vs spells, Diff 8), Accuracy (+1 to hit on weapon, Diff 9), Striding (+1 Movement, Diff 8). Rune bonuses do not stack with magical bonuses from other items.

specialRules.name: Extra Set of Hands
specialRules.text: Allows the Runesmith to inscribe two items before each game instead of one.

specialRules.name: Deathwish
specialRules.text: Immune to all psychology and never needs to test if fighting alone.

specialRules.name: No missiles or armour
specialRules.text: May never carry or use missile weapons or any form of armour.

specialRules.name: Stubborn
specialRules.text: May reroll any failed Leadership test (no reroll of a reroll).

conversionNotes: Troll Slayer cannot use missile weapons or armour; equipmentList is the full Dwarf Warrior list, restriction in specialRules.
Gromril Weapon listed with listCost 0 and cost 'x3 normal' in note (no fixed cost printed). Brace of pistols (30gc) split out from Pistol.

Dwarf Special Skills (True Grit, Combat Master, Thick Skull, Extra Tough, Resource Hunter, Ferocious Charge, Monster Slayer, Berserker) are not transcribed as fighter data; their d6 wording (True Grit injury 1-3/4-5/6, Thick Skull 3+/2+, Monster Slayer 4+) would convert to d12 as 1-6/7-10/11-12 (judgement), 5+/3+, 7+.
Rune Difficulty levels are 2D6 targets and were left unchanged; Rune of Warding special 4+ save left as printed (would be 7+ on d12).
Max profile (not in schema): M3 WS7 BS6 S4 T5 W3 I5 A4 Ld10.
Rangers are also subject to ordinary Dwarf warband special rules which are not in this PDF.
Apprentice, Troll Slayer starting exp: 0 and 8; no 'min' beyond Runesmith 1.
